rewordings.text: Tell me what your team makes or ships day to day.
Walk me through your operation — what are you producing?
What business are you in and what does your product look like going out the door?
Help me understand what you make and how it gets packaged.
What packaging items are you using most right now?
What are your highest-volume packaging materials?
Which packaging SKUs do you go through the fastest?
What packaging materials run through your operation every week?
How often are you placing packaging orders — weekly, monthly, or as needed?
Do you order on a set schedule or more as things run out?
What's your typical reorder cycle for packaging supplies?
How regularly are you restocking packaging materials?
Where are your current packaging prices landing these days?
What are you paying for your main packaging items right now?
Have your packaging costs moved much in the last year?
What's your current pricing on your top-volume items?
If we can improve cost or performance, are you open to switching?
What would need to happen for you to try a new supplier?
How locked in are you with your current vendor — any contracts in place?
If we hit your numbers on price and delivery, what would be the next step?
How do your products usually get to customers today?
What carriers or ship methods are you using most?
Are you doing mostly LTL, parcel, or truckload?
How is finished product leaving your facility?
Roughly what volume are you buying in a typical month?
What does a typical month look like for packaging volume?
How many cases or rolls are you going through monthly?
What's your average monthly usage on your top packaging items?
Who are your main packaging suppliers right now?
Who are you sourcing your packaging from currently?
Which distributors or manufacturers are you working with today?
Who handles most of your packaging supply?
When is your next packaging order likely coming up?
When do you typically place your next order?
Do you have a reorder coming up soon — what's your timeline?
When would be the best time to follow up with a quote?
Who else in your space is growing and might need similar support?
Are there other facilities or sister plants we should be talking to?
Who do you know in the industry that might be a good fit for us?
Any other companies in your network with similar packaging needs?

fakes: What's your biggest packaging challenge right now?
How many employees do you have on the floor?
Do you have a dedicated purchasing department?
What are your lead time requirements for critical items?
Are you ISO certified or working toward any quality certifications?
What does your warehouse layout look like — racking, floor stack, or both?
How far in advance do you plan your packaging orders?
What's your annual packaging budget?
Do you have preferred brands or materials you specify?
Are you the decision maker, or is there someone else I should loop in?
What's been your biggest supply chain pain point this year?
Have you ever tried stocking your own inventory vs. just-in-time ordering?
What software are you using to manage purchasing or inventory?
What does your vendor approval process look like for new suppliers?
How many packaging SKUs are you actively managing right now?
Do you ever have quality or consistency issues with your current supplier?
What's your return or credit policy with your current supplier?
Do you consolidate all packaging into one order or buy items separately?
What's your minimum order quantity with your current supplier?
Are you planning to expand your facility in the next year or two?
How often do you run out of stock before your next order arrives?
What payment terms are you on with your current supplier?
Do you ever use custom-printed or branded packaging?
What supplier certifications are most important to you?
Have supply chain disruptions affected your packaging availability recently?
